lighting_notes: Formal interior light — neutral/cool, not warm, to match the rigid/orthodox tone. Mr. and Mrs. Sharma seated on antique mahogany chairs; Ananya standing, so a slightly low-angle medium shot on the parents and eye-level or slightly elevated on Ananya would reinforce the power dynamic.
action: Ananya stands before her seated parents. Mrs. Sharma gasps softly at Ananya's line; Mr. Sharma's eyes narrow. Silence, then his rigid posture eases into reluctant acceptance.

dialogue.line: The family has prestige to uphold, Ananya. We have chosen a suitable match.
Father... I have already given my heart to someone.
His name is Rohit. We studied together. He is honest and kind. Please... meet him once.

continuity_notes: First appearance of all three characters. Establishes Mr. Sharma's rigidity and Ananya's quiet resolve — both payoff later in sc08's disownment scene, which reuses this same location.
